title: Fire Hazard for Air fryers
text: Fire Hazard for Air fryers. I usually use aluminum foil for the air fryer and I replaced it for this one. It got sucked in and it was smoking everywhere. I would consider this as a fire hazard.

product_metadata.title: Katbite 200Pcs 7.5 In Air Fryer Liners, Parchment Paper for Air Fryer, Unbleached Disposable Air Fryer Liners Paper Sheets Square for Air Fryer, Steaming Basket, Oven Baking
features: HEAVY-DUTY & EXTRA STRONG：7.5x7.5 inch unbleached parchment paper 200PCS are made of extra thicker 45gsm paper compared to their common 35gsm or 40gsm paper, our paper is thicker than theirs. Pre-cut parchment liners are perfect for air fryers or cake pans larger than 7.5 inches. It also can be used in bamboo or metal steamer.

SAVE TIME & SAVE PROBLEM: Pre-cut square air frier cookers liners can save you a lot of baking time, and perforated parchment paper allows you to speed up the steam circulation through the air fryer or steamer and ensure that the food is heated evenly. Enjoy your meal!

NATURAL & FOOD SAFETY: Air fryer parchment paper liners are made of pure wood pulp and fluorescent-free.Unbleached, Non-toxic, and Non-stick ensure food safety and taste and keep food complete appearances such as bread, chicken, and snacks.

HEAT RESISTANT: Parchment paper sheets for air fryer temperature resistance is from -68 to 425 degrees Fahrenheit. The double silicone coating side keeps food out of direct contact with the fryer and causes stains. Easy to clean.

CAUTION: Do not add airfryer liner in pre-heating mode! Keep the paper under when adding food, Be sure not to let the paper contact the heating tube, the temperature of the heating tube is much higher than the heat-resisting temperature of the paper. The unbleached air fryer liners are disposable.
